evals.name: Answer which task covers a success criterion
evals.prompt: Use the plan-review skill on PR #5. GitHub and the network are unavailable, so don't call gh. Instead: pr/ in the current directory holds the plan PR's files at its head commit (the-marmack/intents PR #5, a draft), pm/ holds the PM repo the-marmack/intent-themarmack at the locked commit, the target repo the-marmack/label-reprint doesn't exist yet, and the review guides aren't available (skip them). The reviewer asks: 'Which task makes sure a reprint reaches the printer in under 5 seconds, and what does it depend on?' Write your answer to answer.md.
expectations: The answer names Task 3 and SC2, and says Task 3 depends on Task 2.

assertions.run: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('pr/intents/themarmack-7-label-reprint/plan.json')); assert len(d['tasks'])==3" && grep -q '^### Task 4' pr/intents/themarmack-7-label-reprint/plan.md
